item.title: Madison Diocesan Choir offering youth scholarship
item.description: Local MADISON — The Madison Diocesan Choir is again offering the Patrick Gorman Youth Pastoral Musician Scholarship. These scholarships are meant to encourage continued participation in music ministries by supporting summer music education for youth attending a summer music clinic. The scholarship amount is $700 per award winner.
